Earlier AI guesses versus reported city counts

The original Santa Clara comparison is preserved. Blue = reported 2025 total; amber = earlier AI guess. These subjective guesses were made after reported data appeared in the conversation, so this is not an independent test of AI bias. No invented statewide predictions are presented as measured data.

Coverage and sources

58 county boundaries · 483 incorporated city/town boundaries · 52 county-specific count records · 2 combined-county count records covering the other 6 counties · 24 public shelter/interim-housing pins. Santa Clara retains the detailed municipal count breakdown. Other city boundaries are navigable, but this release does not yet contain their city-level counts.

Counts are dated 2023–2025 snapshots, with the year displayed for each area; they are not current totals. Combined-county figures remain combined; they are not duplicated or divided among counties. Los Angeles uses the finalized 2025 countywide total, including its separately reporting cities.

  • Santa Clara County PIT report and San Diego 2025 count.
  • September 2025 compilation of locally released CoC counts: other county/region records. Ratios recomputed from individual rows; source summary arithmetic is not reused.
  • Census TIGERweb incorporated places, retrieved September 9, 2026. County cartography: US Atlas 10m Census-derived geometry; generalized boundaries are not survey lines and differ in vintage from cities.
  • Each public shelter entry links to its source. These sources span 2025–2026, not a single PIT-night inventory. Confidential and rotating locations are omitted.
  • LA County public GIS shelter/services directory: optional historical layer, mostly records last updated in 2020. Includes offices and other services; excluded from shelter counts and hidden by default.

The map engine, boundaries, and data are embedded in this file. No API key or boundary download is needed. The map draws embedded boundary geometry and uses no external street tiles. Leaflet attribution is retained.
